summary: Vista Energy, S.A.B. de C.V. filed a Form 6-K reporting an August 11, 2026 open-market repurchase of 50,000 Series A shares at MXN $1,141.81 per share, totaling approximately MXN $57.1 million, under an authorization from the April 28, 2026 shareholders' meeting. Post-repurchase, 110,767,402 Series A shares were outstanding and 1,534,351 were held in treasury. Citi México Casa de Bolsa executed the trades. This is a routine issuer buyback disclosure under a standing program. What to watch: continued buyback cadence and treasury accumulation against future capital-return decisions.
